test_definitions.name: Source pin
test_definitions.valid_condition: Hashes, lineage, cutoff and consumer refer to exact inputs.
test_definitions.invalid_example: Alter a checksum or silently use another AIM file.
test_definitions.expected_rejection: Input/version check rejects the altered input.

test_definitions.name: Commercial level
test_definitions.valid_condition: Upstream billing and downstream quantities are separate facts.
test_definitions.invalid_example: Add downstream valuation to billing as one revenue total.
test_definitions.expected_rejection: Metric contract rejects mixed-level total.

test_definitions.name: Row grain and controls
test_definitions.valid_condition: Monthly facts reconcile to compatible annual/dealer controls.
test_definitions.invalid_example: Include annual summary and month rows in the same sum.
test_definitions.expected_rejection: Double counting is detected; controls excluded from observations.

test_definitions.name: Keys and join conservation
test_definitions.valid_condition: Raw part/account identifiers preserved; one classification or unmatched result per fact.
test_definitions.invalid_example: Introduce duplicate canonical PN labels or a normalisation collision.
test_definitions.expected_rejection: Join amplification/collision is reported and blocked.

test_definitions.name: Signed quantities
test_definitions.valid_condition: Returns and adjustments follow documented source convention.
test_definitions.invalid_example: Drop negative rows or flip their sign.
test_definitions.expected_rejection: Reconciliation fails with a signed-value exception.

test_definitions.name: Period completeness
test_definitions.valid_condition: Complete periods established from source coverage; CY and FY separate.
test_definitions.invalid_example: Treat missing month as zero or sum CY and FY.
test_definitions.expected_rejection: Unknown state preserved; mixed-clock calculation rejected.

test_definitions.name: Historical scope
test_definitions.valid_condition: CY2025 dealer panel identified as historical; network history separate.
test_definitions.invalid_example: Allocate 2026 network totals into 2025 dealers to imply current activity.
test_definitions.expected_rejection: Unsupported dealer history is rejected.

test_definitions.name: Reference valuation
test_definitions.valid_condition: Eligible signed quantity times documented price/unit/currency; unpriced remains unknown.
test_definitions.invalid_example: Use missing price as zero or label reference value as dealer invoices.
test_definitions.expected_rejection: Unpriced coverage/semantic failure visible; no revenue label.

test_definitions.name: Fleet denominator
test_definitions.valid_condition: Only verified appropriate fleet supports a per-truck metric.
test_definitions.invalid_example: Copy or sales-allocate market UIO into dealer rows.
test_definitions.expected_rejection: Dealer euro-per-truck unavailable; field quarantined.

test_definitions.name: Classification-only adapter
test_definitions.valid_condition: No accidental AIM billing values enter dealer facts/payload.
test_definitions.invalid_example: Add l12m_billed_eur from full AIM master to a dealer view.
test_definitions.expected_rejection: Unscoped commercial field rejected and totals unchanged.

test_definitions.name: Mix and alternatives
test_definitions.valid_condition: Category mix and approved part alternatives have separate contracts.
test_definitions.invalid_example: Treat same family as fitment approval or undefined capture as market share.
test_definitions.expected_rejection: Part-alternative/capture assertion blocked.

test_definitions.name: Unit and denominator
test_definitions.valid_condition: Mix uses compatible units or a declared value basis with valid denominator.
test_definitions.invalid_example: Aggregate pads and kits as service counts, or render share with zero/negative denominator.
test_definitions.expected_rejection: Unsupported total/share withheld with explanation.

test_definitions.name: Identity
test_definitions.valid_condition: Approved relationship used only at supported account/site grain.
test_definitions.invalid_example: Fuzzy-match an account to IDS or duplicate an account across sites.
test_definitions.expected_rejection: Link remains unresolved; account totals not duplicated.

test_definitions.name: Geography
test_definitions.valid_condition: Verified account location represented; unmapped still in totals/list.
test_definitions.invalid_example: Infer distributor from country, invent a location or rank underperformance without fleet.
test_definitions.expected_rejection: Invalid mapping/performance claim rejected.

test_definitions.name: IDS scope/date
test_definitions.valid_condition: Available round, totals/detail and unknown date shown faithfully.
test_definitions.invalid_example: Create question scores or use file timestamp as assessment date.
test_definitions.expected_rejection: Unsupported detail/date rejected; no distributor audit label.

test_definitions.name: Tonnage v2
test_definitions.valid_condition: Exclusive purchasing, modelled demand and market actuals remain distinct.
test_definitions.invalid_example: Sum also_fits_band, allocate shared parts or multiply repeated market actuals.
test_definitions.expected_rejection: Non-additive/allocated result blocked without reopening resolved v1 issues.

test_definitions.name: PRISM parity
test_definitions.valid_condition: Same pinned inputs/basis produce matching reused metric or documented blocker.
test_definitions.invalid_example: Substitute another model vintage or account-allocate a market output.
test_definitions.expected_rejection: Parity/scope failure identified; no false validation.

test_definitions.name: Context navigation
test_definitions.valid_condition: Distributor/family/period/basis persist; account change clears incompatible IDS link.
test_definitions.invalid_example: Leave old account/assessment filter in hidden state.
test_definitions.expected_rejection: Stale association cleared or blocked with explicit state.

test_definitions.name: Action evidence
test_definitions.valid_condition: Draft links to exact source snapshot and permitted account/market scope.
test_definitions.invalid_example: Create an action using another account or unapproved IDS question.
test_definitions.expected_rejection: Invalid evidence link blocked; optional IDS relationship stays optional.

test_definitions.name: Boundary and privacy
test_definitions.valid_condition: All writes inside fresh work root; returned prototype is synthetic.
test_definitions.invalid_example: Embed dealer-named detail, broader billing or private identity table.
test_definitions.expected_rejection: Payload/export inspection fails; excluded material is not returned.

test_definitions.name: Empty and unavailable modules
test_definitions.valid_condition: Tender/price/IDS absence is visibly labelled and no current fact invented.
test_definitions.invalid_example: Show synthetic notices/prices as current observations.
test_definitions.expected_rejection: Synthetic/unavailable state enforced.

test_definitions.name: Usability
test_definitions.valid_condition: Keyboard/list alternative and readable essential labels support the review task.
test_definitions.invalid_example: Require hover/colour/map-only interpretation to understand a limitation.
test_definitions.expected_rejection: Scenario fails usability until textual/keyboard alternative is available.
